### Finding one

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Bars graded by value; dashed line = portfolio base rate."
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
bars = ax.bar(seg, val, color=graded(val), edgecolor="white")
bar_labels(ax, bars); add_baseline(ax, 8.1, label="Base {:.1f}%")
chart_title(ax, "Default rate by segment", "Demo data"); ax.margins(y=0.15)
plt.show()
```

The [segment A]{.stat} rate is half again the base rate.

::: {.caveat}
Small sample in segment E (n = 412) — treat its rate as indicative.
:::
